instruction: Arrange my "~/photographs/vacations/" directory by organizing the photos from three vacations. The files created in January and April of this year correspond to Athens and Seoul, respectively, while the others are from Paris. Move them into sub-directories named after their respective vacation spots, maintaining the original file names.
notes: Main app is file_system; phone.get_current_date_and_time (no login needed) is modeled as a nullary action whose effect (current-date-known) supplies the current year needed to decide which files are from January/April of 'this year', and it gates every move_file. The directory contents are unknown up front, so the problem uses representative placeholder files (two per vacation: January-2023 -> Athens, April-2023 -> Seoul, any other creation date -> Paris); at runtime the agent iterates over every file returned by show_directory and classifies it by the created_at field of show_file. Knowledge flow: show_profile -> username, show_account_passwords -> file_system password, login -> token, show_directory marks the directory as listed (gates show_file on its files), show_file yields (known-created-in f), which together with (current-date-known) gates move_file. move_file is only applicable toward the sub-directory designated for the file's creation month (month-destination) with the destination path that keeps the original base name (dest-path), so every move is correct by construction; it also decrements a discrete counter of files still to organize. Because quantified goals are not allowed, the goal is the counter reaching count-0 (declared as a domain constant so supervisor-complete-task can require it), which holds exactly when all files have been moved into the correct Athens/Seoul/Paris sub-directories. Extra non-API parameters (?d on show_file; ?from ?to ?m ?n ?n1 on move_file) only serve bookkeeping. move_file creates the target sub-directories implicitly, no directory is deleted, and supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (task-completed).

plan: (file-system-move-file photo-apr-1 seoul-photo-apr-1 file-system-token vacations-dir seoul-dir april-2023 count-6 count-5)
(file-system-move-file photo-apr-2 seoul-photo-apr-2 file-system-token vacations-dir seoul-dir april-2023 count-5 count-4)
(file-system-move-file photo-jan-1 athens-photo-jan-1 file-system-token vacations-dir athens-dir january-2023 count-4 count-3)
(file-system-move-file photo-jan-2 athens-photo-jan-2 file-system-token vacations-dir athens-dir january-2023 count-3 count-2)
(file-system-move-file photo-other-1 paris-photo-other-1 file-system-token vacations-dir paris-dir other-date count-2 count-1)
(file-system-move-file photo-other-2 paris-photo-other-2 file-system-token vacations-dir paris-dir other-date count-1 count-0)
